thread:
Maya: Heads up — HelioXR flagged a billing spike on invoice INV-2026-1009. Looks like two ingestion jobs duplicated usage (ingest-prod-1 + ingest-prod-2). Estimated overcharge ~ $18,420. Requesting manual refund + one-time goodwill promo. Need approvals & journal code. @Jon @Priya

Jon: Ugh, thanks. Do we have raw usage logs to confirm duplication? Also are they post-pay?

Priya: They are post-pay. I can pull logs. @BillingBot please: invoice_lookup INV-2026-1009 and usage_diff helioxr 2026-03-01 2026-03-31

BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-1009 found. Total billed: $92,100. Potential duplicate entries: 2026-03-15 ingest-prod-1 (48,600 tokens) and 2026-03-15 ingest-prod-2 (48,600 tokens). Flag score: 0.92.

Maya: Proposal: issue manual credit for $18,420 (full duplicate) + a one-time 20% goodwill promo on next invoice (~$14,340) => total credit $32,760. Need Alex (Accounting) to approve GL/journal code and sign-off from Finance lead.

Eric: Customer already escalated to AE — they want a quick fix. 20% goodwill sounds fine. :thumbsup:

Alex (Accounting): @Maya please provide GL code and memo. I'll need an approval chain recorded. Also confirm we can apply the promo per TOS.

Maya: GL code: 7003-REFUNDS. Memo: 'Duplicate ingestion billing — HelioXR — INV-2026-1009'. Approvers: Jon (Sales), Priya (Billing), Eric (CS). I'll prepare the chargeback entry and attach memo.

Jon: I approve. Confirming 20% goodwill.

Priya: I approve. I'll run the manual refund in the billing console and mark adjustment type = manual_adjustment.

Eric: Approved from CS. I'll notify the customer and tell them to expect credit on next invoice.

Maya: @BillingBot create_adjustment INV-2026-1009 amount 32760 code 7003-REFUNDS note 'Duplicate ingestion + goodwill' tag: helioxr

BillingBot: Adjustment created: ADJ-2143658701-01 status: pending_accounting_approval.

Alex (Accounting): Approved. I'll post ADJ-2143658701-01 to the ledger today. Please attach signed memo to Jira FIN-4521 before EOD.

Maya: Memo uploaded and linked to FIN-4521. @Eric please send a short customer note: "We apologize — we've issued a credit of $32,760 (ADJ-2143658701-01) and applied a one-time goodwill promotion to your account. You'll see this on your next invoice."

Eric: Drafted and sent. Customer replied: 'Thanks — please confirm when posted so we can close the ticket.'

Priya: Refund run and adjustment queued. Will mark thread resolved once ledger posts. Follow-up: we should run a quick audit to catch similar duplicate-ingest patterns across March.

Maya: Good call. @BillingBot duplicate_scan date_range 2026-03-01 2026-03-31 threshold 0.9 -> report FIN-4522

BillingBot: duplicate_scan started. Report FIN-4522 created with 3 hits. Attaching summary to FIN-4522.

Maya: Thanks team. Leaving thread open until ledger shows posted and customer confirms.

Eric: Customer confirmed they'll wait for the confirmation email. Closing on our side when ADJ posts.

Priya: Ledger shows ADJ-2143658701-01 posted at 2026-04-02 15:12 UTC. Marking as done.

Maya: Marking thread resolved. Will follow up if duplicate_scan finds more systemic issues.
